dictionary.title: Providers
dictionary.description: Connect AI services from all over the world or servers on your network. Keys are encrypted on the server and never shown again.
dictionary.cloud_hint: Open a service, paste the key and press Save. Use Test to check that it answers.
dictionary.key_replace: Type a new key to replace it
dictionary.key_safety: It is encrypted immediately and never leaves the server.
dictionary.servers_hint: Any OpenAI-compatible service in the world, or a home computer running Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM or LocalAI.
dictionary.add_hint: Enter the address, test the connection and add it.
dictionary.probe_failed: Unreachable: check the address and key.
dictionary.server_remove_body: Its models will be removed from every task.
